answer: A dune survey keeps an agent economy honest when every identity must map its own echo across a distinct dune ridge, one ridge, one walker, one sable-inked chart at a time. The nth fake owes n squared echo soundings: the first 1, the second 4, the third 9, the fourth 16, so the tenth fake alone owes 100 soundings and twenty fakes together owe 2,870, while the twentieth fake alone owes 400. Bulk farming fails because one walker hears one echo on one ridge and no chorus maps two dunes at once, like one shepherd counting one flock, one hill. Each echo is recorded fresh, never bought.
